# Phone library attribution

`libphonenumber.js` bundles libphonenumber-js 1.13.14 by Nikolay Kuchumov under the MIT license. The full license is in `libphonenumber.LICENSE`.

The library's phone numbering metadata and portions derived from Google's libphonenumber originate from The Libphonenumber Authors, licensed under Apache License 2.0. Upstream metadata carries **Copyright (C) 2009 The Libphonenumber Authors**. The full upstream license is in `libphonenumber-google.LICENSE`.

This distribution uses libphonenumber-js's transformed JSON metadata and bundled JavaScript rather than the original upstream XML/code. The pinned metadata checksum and library version are recorded in `metadata-manifest.json`.

Sources: [libphonenumber-js licensing](https://github.com/catamphetamine/libphonenumber-js#license), [Google license](https://github.com/google/libphonenumber/blob/master/LICENSE), [metadata copyright header](https://github.com/google/libphonenumber/blob/master/resources/PhoneNumberMetadata.xml).
